note: Ceiling for the published image (#2132). Compressed bytes - what crosses the wire on a pull. MEASURED IN CI (ubuntu-latest, docker-build-smoke.yml), because that is the environment that gates. A local run can legitimately differ by base-image and apt-package drift - 125.6 MB in CI against 112.3 MB locally on the same commit - so never lower this to match a laptop. Lower it with --update-baseline from a CI measurement; raising it needs --allow-raise and belongs in a commit that says why.
_tightening: Tightening stays MANUAL (#2140): the gate offers headroom above the jitter tolerance but never applies it. This ceiling is a CI measurement; a local run lowering it would pin the project to one machine's number (#2134).
_per_arch_note: Per-architecture ceilings (#2147). amd64 carries the CI measurement from docker-build-smoke.yml. arm64 is DELIBERATELY absent: it has never been measured, and the gate fails closed rather than letting it borrow amd64's number - two published architectures are two environments (#2136 point 5). Seed it from the first publish run, on the native arm64 runner: verify_image_size.py --image <ref> --arch arm64 --update-baseline
